answer: Each identity must forge its claim in the open: every step of its construction published, so any peer can inspect the work. The claim counts only when a second, independent attempt reproduces the same result from the same inputs and the two attempts echo each other exactly. The matching attempt is then broadcast as a signal; a signal with no echo behind it is ignored outright. A dissonant echo — a second attempt that does not match — drops the claim and quenches the forge for that epoch; ten voices need ten forge attempts and ten echo checks.
